feat: the run pane shows the run's own work-log writes that failed (#11)

AgentRun keeps record_failed (proof-agents#16): each of its own writes that
failed this Start (closing note, suggested redirect, turn record) with the
hook and error. The run card lists them as text under the decision, saying
they are not in the work log and are held by this Start only; status, reason,
decision and controls are as before. A run without the field, or with none
failed, shows nothing.

Closes #11

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+def test_a_closing_note_the_project_could_not_take_reaches_the_run_pane_beside_the_decision(studio, monkeypatch):
+    """proof-web#11: the run keeps its own failed work-log writes (proof-agents#16); the studio hands them to the pane."""
+    from dataclasses import fields
+
+    from proof_agents.agent_run import RunState
+
+    if "record_failed" not in {f.name for f in fields(RunState)}:
+        pytest.skip("needs proof-agents#16")
+    store, hub, log, queue = studio
+
+    def full(self, node_id, role, name, status, note):
+        raise OSError("disk full")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(StudioHub, "_record_close", full)
+    create_node(store, node_id="T", kind="theorem", statement="the main theorem")
+    # the standalone Decomposer's split with no needs-human step of its own: the run's closing note is its decision's record
+    _queue(queue, [["proof", "node", "split", "T", "--child", "T1=the first half", "--child", "T2=the second half", "--created-by", "claude-code"]])
+    assert _post(hub, "/studio/T/api/agent/start", {"provider": "claude", "roles": ["decomposer"]})[0] == 200
+    decision = "structure proposed (2 Claim(s): T1, T2); the researcher decides"
+    state = _until(lambda: (lambda s: s if s["status"] == "needs-human" and s["record_failed"] else None)(_get(hub, "/studio/T/api/agent/run")[1]),
+                   "the run ended needs-human with its failed note")
+    assert state["decision"] == decision and state["record_failed"] == {"_close_note": "record_close: OSError: disk full"}
+    assert proof_map.require_node(store, "T").dependencies == ["T1", "T2"]
+    assert not [e for e in work_log(store, "T") if e.get("kind") == "step" and e.get("status") == "needs-human"]  # not in the work log
+
 def test_the_run_leaves_a_closing_note_on_every_stop(studio):
     store, hub, log, queue = studio
     write_key_ideas(store, "N")
